query:
INSERT INTO quickfireQuestions
  (type, question, reviewAnswer, echoCategory, category, difficulty, isActive, submissionStatus)
VALUES
('quickReview','What is the normal PSV in the celiac artery?','100–200 cm/s','abdominal_vascular','Abdominal Vascular','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal PSV in the superior mesenteric artery (SMA) fasting?','<275 cm/s (fasting); increases postprandially','abdominal_vascular','Abdominal Vascular','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What PSV in the renal artery indicates significant stenosis?','>180–200 cm/s (renal-to-aortic ratio >3.5)','abdominal_vascular','Abdominal Vascular','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal renal-to-aortic ratio (RAR)?','<3.5','abdominal_vascular','Abdominal Vascular','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the resistive index (RI) formula?','(PSV - EDV) / PSV','abdominal_vascular','Abdominal Vascular','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal renal artery RI?','0.58–0.70','abdominal_vascular','Abdominal Vascular','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal abdominal aorta diameter?','<3 cm (≥3 cm = AAA)','abdominal_vascular','Abdominal Vascular','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal PSV in the abdominal aorta at the level of the renal arteries?','60–100 cm/s','abdominal_vascular','Abdominal Vascular','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the tardus-parvus waveform?','Delayed systolic upstroke and reduced PSV — indicates proximal stenosis','abdominal_vascular','Abdominal Vascular','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal PSV in the hepatic artery?','<200 cm/s (RI 0.55–0.70)','abdominal_vascular','Abdominal Vascular','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the hepatic artery RI after liver transplant that suggests rejection?','>0.80 or <0.50','abdominal_vascular','Abdominal Vascular','advanced',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal portal vein flow direction and velocity?','Hepatopetal (toward liver); 15–40 cm/s','abdominal_vascular','Abdominal Vascular','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is portal hypertension and what Doppler findings suggest it?','Elevated portal pressure; findings: hepatofugal flow, splenomegaly, varices, ascites','abdominal_vascular','Abdominal Vascular','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal PSV in the splenic artery?','Variable; low-resistance waveform (RI ~0.55–0.65)','abdominal_vascular','Abdominal Vascular','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal PSV in the inferior mesenteric artery (IMA)?','<200 cm/s','abdominal_vascular','Abdominal Vascular','advanced',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the Dunbar syndrome (median arcuate ligament syndrome)?','Compression of the celiac artery by the median arcuate ligament — causes post-prandial pain','abdominal_vascular','Abdominal Vascular','advanced',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal PSV in the vertebral artery on duplex?','20–60 cm/s; asymmetry >1:1.5 may indicate stenosis','abdominal_vascular','Abdominal Vascular','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal PSV in the renal vein?','Variable; phasic with respiration','abdominal_vascular','Abdominal Vascular','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal PSV in the common carotid artery (CCA)?','60–90 cm/s','extracranial_carotid','Extracranial Carotid','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal PSV in the internal carotid artery (ICA)?','<125 cm/s','extracranial_carotid','Extracranial Carotid','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What PSV in the ICA indicates 50–69% stenosis?','125–230 cm/s','extracranial_carotid','Extracranial Carotid','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What PSV in the ICA indicates ≥70% stenosis?','>230 cm/s','extracranial_carotid','Extracranial Carotid','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the ICA/CCA ratio and what value indicates significant stenosis?','ICA PSV / CCA PSV; ratio >4.0 = ≥70% stenosis','extracranial_carotid','Extracranial Carotid','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal intima-media thickness (IMT) of the CCA?','<0.9 mm (>1.0 mm = increased cardiovascular risk)','extracranial_carotid','Extracranial Carotid','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the sonographic appearance of a carotid plaque?','Focal intimal thickening >1.5 mm or IMT >1.5 mm protruding into the lumen','extracranial_carotid','Extracranial Carotid','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the difference between echogenic and echolucent plaque?','Echogenic = calcified/fibrous (stable); echolucent = lipid-rich/hemorrhagic (unstable, higher stroke risk)','extracranial_carotid','Extracranial Carotid','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal external carotid artery (ECA) waveform?','High-resistance (triphasic) waveform with temporal tap response','extracranial_carotid','Extracranial Carotid','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal ICA waveform?','Low-resistance (biphasic) waveform with continuous forward diastolic flow','extracranial_carotid','Extracranial Carotid','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the vertebral artery steal syndrome?','Subclavian steal — retrograde vertebral flow due to subclavian artery stenosis proximal to vertebral origin','extracranial_carotid','Extracranial Carotid','advanced',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal PSV in the vertebral artery?','20–60 cm/s','extracranial_carotid','Extracranial Carotid','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal EDV in the ICA?','<40 cm/s','extracranial_carotid','Extracranial Carotid','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What EDV in the ICA indicates ≥70% stenosis?','>100 cm/s','extracranial_carotid','Extracranial Carotid','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the carotid bulb and why is it important?','Widened segment at the ICA origin — most common site for atherosclerotic plaque formation','extracranial_carotid','Extracranial Carotid','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal PSV in the ophthalmic artery?','~30–40 cm/s; flow should be antegrade (away from brain)','extracranial_carotid','Extracranial Carotid','advanced',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the string sign in carotid duplex?','Very thin residual lumen in near-total occlusion — differentiate from complete occlusion','extracranial_carotid','Extracranial Carotid','advanced',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal PSV in the MCA on TCD?','<120 cm/s (mean ~60–80 cm/s)','intracranial_tcd','Intracranial Duplex/TCD','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What PSV in the MCA indicates vasospasm on TCD?','>120 cm/s (severe >200 cm/s)','intracranial_tcd','Intracranial Duplex/TCD','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the Lindegaard ratio and what does it indicate?','MCA PSV / ICA PSV; >3 = vasospasm (not hyperemia); >6 = severe vasospasm','intracranial_tcd','Intracranial Duplex/TCD','advanced',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal depth for insonating the MCA on TCD?','45–65 mm (via temporal window)','intracranial_tcd','Intracranial Duplex/TCD','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal depth for insonating the ACA on TCD?','60–80 mm (via temporal window)','intracranial_tcd','Intracranial Duplex/TCD','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal depth for insonating the PCA on TCD?','55–75 mm (via temporal window)','intracranial_tcd','Intracranial Duplex/TCD','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal depth for insonating the basilar artery on TCD?','80–120 mm (via suboccipital window)','intracranial_tcd','Intracranial Duplex/TCD','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal depth for insonating the vertebral artery on TCD?','40–80 mm (via suboccipital window)','intracranial_tcd','Intracranial Duplex/TCD','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal PSV in the ACA on TCD?','<90 cm/s (mean ~50–60 cm/s)','intracranial_tcd','Intracranial Duplex/TCD','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal PSV in the basilar artery on TCD?','<60 cm/s (mean ~40–50 cm/s)','intracranial_tcd','Intracranial Duplex/TCD','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the embolic signal (HITS) on TCD?','High-intensity transient signal — indicates microemboli (gaseous or particulate)','intracranial_tcd','Intracranial Duplex/TCD','advanced',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal pulsatility index (PI) on TCD?','0.6–1.1 (elevated PI >1.2 = increased ICP or distal resistance)','intracranial_tcd','Intracranial Duplex/TCD','intermediate',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the optic nerve sheath diameter (ONSD) threshold for elevated ICP?','>5.0 mm (measured 3 mm behind the globe)','intracranial_tcd','Intracranial Duplex/TCD','advanced',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal flow direction in the MCA on TCD?','Toward the probe (positive deflection on spectral display)','intracranial_tcd','Intracranial Duplex/TCD','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal flow direction in the ACA on TCD?','Away from the probe (negative deflection on spectral display)','intracranial_tcd','Intracranial Duplex/TCD','beginner',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the sickle cell disease TCD threshold for stroke risk?','MCA or ACA PSV ≥200 cm/s (STOP trial)','intracranial_tcd','Intracranial Duplex/TCD','advanced',1,'draft'),
('quickReview','What is the normal PSV in the vertebral artery on duplex?','20–60 cm/s; asymmetry >1:1.5 may indicate stenosis','extracranial_carotid','Extracranial Carotid','intermediate',1,'draft')
